execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a surviving MRCS tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries it through implementation, required validation, verified closeout and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated source archaeology and other family work.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, evidence verification, reconciliation and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: Split before governed start if the selected tranche cannot credibly preserve the closeout reserve.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MRCS productizes and expands the existing Multiversal Content Forge rather than creating a parallel authoring database or canonical rules engine
owner-domain contracts remain authoritative for governed definition semantics
CAB remains completed advancement/balance authority and cannot be silently reopened or superseded
CNI retains modular conditional-content runtime authority
reduced GPR plus Action/Event and other runtime owners execute accepted definitions; MRCS never treats preview or authoring state as live occurrence truth
PCA-12 and PDCP Packet 08 own generic simulation/formal-analysis machinery; MRCS-17 supplies rule/content model adapters, CAB harness integration, impact interpretation and evidence attachment only
PDCP Packet 07 owns generic preview/dry-run/commit/explanation/intervention/compensation/debug semantics; MRCS uses those semantics rather than creating a parallel creator framework

ARI/PCA retain generic resource identity, source/derivative lineage, rights/use capability, provenance, version/review and import-export infrastructure; MRCS-19 supplies rule/content mapping, migration and pack lifecycle only
MCS, MCCS, MNCS, MAS and MSAS retain specialized creator-domain ownership; MRCS binds accepted outputs without absorbing those domains
MERA and MBES consume accepted engineering/construction/material/facility definitions but retain engineering and built-environment execution authority
definition, variant, template, form, placement, live instance and projection/stat-block layers remain distinct
mechanical prose references governed Actions, Effects, Conditions, Resources, Abilities and other shared records where available rather than duplicating mechanics in prose
ordinary authoring is no-code; advanced formulas/predicates/selectors remain bounded and inspectable without unrestricted scripting by default
core, setting, campaign, adventure and playtest rule scopes require explicit precedence, compatibility, enable/disable and rollback behavior
content cannot be labeled balanced solely from schema validity; owner-approved CAB/domain evidence is required where applicable
legacy import and repair preserve source text, source prices, aliases/history and unresolved source gaps rather than inventing missing semantics
unknown compatibility, prerequisite, owner data or source semantics remains unresolved rather than inferred
visibility/permission filtering occurs before reference lists, dependency graphs, impact counts, diagnostics, exports and AI context
optional AI remains advisory and cannot publish, canonize or mutate live state
blocking authoring, validation, packaging and review remain usable without paid/cloud providers
proprietary benchmark products remain clean-room planning provenance only
no MRCS implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a surviving MRCS work item
